Immune to [Set 3] Amidala and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image first published as a high-resolution PNG on 1 June 2022 at 01:22:57 UTC.<ref name="pc-first-png-darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi">Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/hires/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.png published PNG], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/13a5f3a50444b0b953aad90805681777b4241fbb commit 13a5f3a], 1 June 2022, 01:22:57 UTC.</ref> The GIF cited below was published at 01:38:55 UTC on the same date and displays the same pixels; it is a later format copy. The current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/darthvaderbetrayerofthejedi.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, if a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, character's game text is canceled (and if Amidala, she is immediately lost). While on Coruscant, adds one [Dark Side] icon here. Immune to [Set 3] Amidala and attrition < 5.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
